meta.title: Delivery
meta.description: Order Vkusno for delivery or pickup from five kitchens in Dubai. Choose a kitchen, then Talabat, Careem, Deliveroo, Noon, Keeta, or order directly from Arjan.

hero.title: Delivery
hero.lead: Home-style Russian food from the kitchen nearest you. You choose the kitchen, then the app that kitchen uses. You pay in that app, not on this website.

direct.title: Order from us
direct.text: From the Arjan kitchen you can order directly. Delivery covers about 30 km, with Careem or Slider riders, and the distance can be a little shorter at busy times. You can also call or message us on WhatsApp.

apps.title: Order on an app
apps.text: Talabat, Careem, Deliveroo, Noon and Keeta. Not every kitchen is on every app. The buttons on a kitchen are the ones that take an order there.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.text: Pickup is available at every kitchen. In the app, choose pickup when that option is shown.

note: Vkusno does not take catering orders.
